name: Text / Interactive Fiction
description: Words, choices, and a story that remembers. The pack splits traversal from condition on purpose: ui.passage_engine owns the graph of text and the interpolation that makes a passage read as though it were written for this reader, while ui.choice_consequence owns the flags that decide which links are offered at all. Keeping them apart is what lets a story be linted -- an unreachable branch is a bug an author wants told about before publication, not discovered by a reader who never sees it. Delayed consequences are first-class, because a decision in chapter one landing in chapter six is the effect the form exists for and the one hardest to hand-roll.
loop: read passage → choose → world state shifts → next passage

signatureCompound.name: A Choice That Lands Six Chapters Later
signatureCompound.description: The branch the form exists for: passage_engine renders a passage and offers its links, choice_consequence records the flag the reader set and schedules it to take effect after a declared number of passages, story_stats surfaces the resolve it quietly moved, and save_bookmark captures position AND flags together so returning to try the other branch lands in a scene the story still believes in.
